# ripn.net
> RIPN is the Russian Institute for Public Networks, providing domain registration, DNS infrastructure, WHOIS/RDAP services, and related registry information.

The site covers RIPN’s registry operations, technical services, public reference tools, policy materials, and organizational information for the .RU and .РФ internet space.

## Registry Services
- [Domain Registration Services](https://www.ripn.net/nic/): Overview of RIPN registry and domain-related services.
- [Registrar Information](https://www.ripn.net/registrators/): Information for accredited registrars and registry interaction.
- [Registry System](https://www.ripn.net/ripn/): Details about RIPN registry systems and operations.
- [Domain Names](https://www.ripn.net/domain/): General information about domain names and registry topics.
- [Coordination Center](https://www.ripn.net/cc/): Materials related to domain coordination and governance.

## Reference Tools
- [WHOIS Service](https://www.ripn.net/nic/whois/): Lookup tool and information for domain registration data.
- [RDAP Service](https://www.ripn.net/rdap/): Registration Data Access Protocol service endpoint and usage information.
- [DNS Check](https://www.ripn.net/nic/dns/): DNS-related reference and validation resources.
- [Search](https://www.ripn.net/search/): Site-wide search for documents, services, and reference pages.

## DNS and Technical Infrastructure
- [DNS Services](https://www.ripn.net/dns/): Information about DNS infrastructure and related technical services.
- [Secondary DNS](https://www.ripn.net/dns/secondary/): Secondary DNS service information and participation details.
- [DNSSEC](https://www.ripn.net/dns/dnssec/): DNSSEC deployment, support, and technical information.
- [Technical Center](https://www.ripn.net/tc/): Technical operations and infrastructure supporting registry services.

## Documents and Policies
- [Documents](https://www.ripn.net/docs/): Central index of official documents, regulations, and reference materials.
- [Rules and Regulations](https://www.ripn.net/docs/rules/): нормативные and procedural documents governing services and operations.
- [Contracts and Forms](https://www.ripn.net/docs/forms/): Standard forms, templates, and service-related documents.
- [Publications](https://www.ripn.net/docs/publications/): Published materials, reports, and informational documents.

## News and Events
- [News](https://www.ripn.net/news/): Official announcements, service updates, and organizational news.
- [Events](https://www.ripn.net/events/): Conferences, meetings, and event-related information.
- [Press Center](https://www.ripn.net/press/): Press materials and media-facing information.

## Support and Contacts
- [Contacts](https://www.ripn.net/about/contacts/): Contact details for departments, offices, and service inquiries.
- [Support](https://www.ripn.net/support/): Support channels and assistance for users and partners.
- [FAQ](https://www.ripn.net/faq/): Frequently asked questions about services and procedures.

## Organization
- [About RIPN](https://www.ripn.net/about/): Overview of the organization, mission, and activities.
- [History](https://www.ripn.net/about/history/): Background and historical information about RIPN.
- [Structure](https://www.ripn.net/about/structure/): Organizational structure and institutional roles.
- [Projects](https://www.ripn.net/projects/): Current and past projects operated by RIPN.

## Resources
- [Public Services](https://www.ripn.net/services/): Index of public-facing services and online tools.
- [Statistics](https://www.ripn.net/stat/): Statistical information related to domains and registry activity.
- [Partners](https://www.ripn.net/partners/): Information about partner organizations and cooperation.
- [Links](https://www.ripn.net/links/): Curated related resources and external references.
